l.i: Quis hic furor? proie[?]ta quæ est audacia?
Spondere Christi audere vos pacem gregi?
Mentita Jesum, quos adhuc fallit cohors,
Et posse fieri somniare ut indicent

main_text.l: lites Hinc venit Pistor, venit & inde faber.
Pontificis pinsit fermentum Pistor, ut inde
In Cereris mutet fragmina parua Deum.
At faber erranti cudit dum forcipe, corpus
Fabricat immensum, quod sit ubique simul.
Os hominum.quis enim tulerit de lumine cæcos
Pistrinum Pistor potius dedatur in ar[?]um
Ut male sanus suos trudere discat suos[?].

page.notes: Long s rendered as s throughout. Line 1 "pe[?]toris" and the "ct" ligature in "proie[?]ta" and "ar[?]um" are doubtful. The last word of the final line is smudged and read as "suos[?]". "hominum.quis" keeps the printed point. The ô and the accents on "implicitóque" are as printed. No marginal notes or catchword.
